sql: with lp as (select distinct on (market_ticker) market_ticker, captured_at, quantity_fp from positions order by market_ticker, captured_at desc), ip as (select distinct on (market_ticker) market_ticker, close_time from incentive_programs where close_time is not null order by market_ticker, last_seen_at desc) select o.market_ticker t, o.side, o.action a, o.status s, o.quantity q, o.limit_price p, left(coalesce(o.client_order_id,''),22) coid, to_char(o.created_at,'MM-DD HH24:MI') at, lp.quantity_fp pos, to_char(lp.captured_at,'MM-DD HH24:MI') snap, to_char(ip.close_time,'MM-DD HH24:MI') close from live_orders o left join lp on lp.market_ticker=o.market_ticker left join ip on ip.market_ticker=o.market_ticker where o.strategy='Alimm1' and (o.status in ('pending','unknown','submitted','resting','partial','filled') ) order by o.created_at desc limit 25
